#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The destination can be a local mount path (e.g. /mnt/backups) or an scp-style
# remote path (e.g. user@host:/srv/backups). Set DEST or BACKUP_DEST in the
# cron environment.
DEST="${DEST:-${BACKUP_DEST:-}}"
if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup destination is not set (set DEST or BACKUP_DEST)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
    *)
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
